output.summary: KEP-5502 proposes an EmptyDir volume permission mode (a stickyBit-style setting for emptyDir volumes). Its status is implementable at stage alpha, and sig-storage approved it from a sig perspective on PR #5857 and PR #6200.
output.rationale: Emptydir volumes lacked a way to set the sticky bit on the volume directory, which the sources describe as a need for some users. The KEP went through several milestone cycles (v1.35 punted, v1.36 and v1.37 freeze misses) before its PRR and sig-storage review completed. The current status is implementable, and the sources record it as tracked for enhancements freeze in v1.37, with the implementation PR approved for code freeze.

alternatives.option: Use a Mode *int32 field in EmptyDirVolumeSource, following SecretVolumeSource
alternatives.why_not: Suggested by jsafrane and haircommander as a possible alternative; the sources do not record it being chosen. The KEP author kept a dedicated stickyBit flag because it is easier to maintain and less error-prone.

alternatives.option: Pass a specific mask or permission directly as an option
alternatives.why_not: Considered by the author, who discarded it in favor of specific flags such as stickyBit for maintainability and error avoidance.

alternatives.option: Track the work as KEP-5855 mount options instead
alternatives.why_not: The sources describe KEP-5855 as a separate, related enhancement for bind mount options on volumeMounts. Both are described as independent enhancements, so it is not a replacement.

evidence.quote: The status of this enhancement is marked as Tracked for enhancements freeze. Please keep the issue description up-to-date with appropriate stages
I already reviewed https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/5857 and this addresses my comments /approve from sig-storage perspective /lgtm
I personally believe having specific flags for what you want to set as mount options (such as stickyBit) is easier to maintain and less error-prone
Both features address different use cases so they fit well as independent enhancements.
we are removing the lead-opted-in and tracked/* labels and milestone to prepare for the next cycle
